scope: Bounded, offline Spark backend/parity preparation. It separates official BF16, official FP8 storage, dequantized derivative artifacts and actual native FP8 execution, defines analytical-only resource inputs, and fails closed on any claim that storage dtype or a small reload success qualifies training. No model is loaded, no download occurs, no native command is authorized, and the MiniCPM5 baseline remains the unchanged default.

baseline.isolation: Spark preparation must not edit MiniCPM5 configs, pins, checkpoints, training defaults or optimizer behavior. No Spark artifact may be loaded as a MiniCPM5 baseline replacement.

guards.trust_remote_code: sealed local source only, hash-verified before load

stop_conditions: swap growth exceeds 536870912 bytes over sustained samples
host free space falls below 15 percent
any CPU fallback or non-exclusive worker is observed

official_bf16.qualification_reason: no native execution or gradient/update evidence exists

official_fp8.activation_quantization: dynamic symmetric per-token F8_E4M3 declared by compressed-tensors
official_fp8.compute_semantics: quantized kernels required; device support unqualified and no MPS result is established
official_fp8.qualification_reason: float8_e4m3fn storage and dynamic activation quantization are not evidence of kernels, gradients or optimizer support

dequantized_fp8_derivative.activation_quantization: none; BF16/FP32 activations with no per-token F8 quantization
dequantized_fp8_derivative.compute_semantics: not the official FP8 forward semantics; a new named artifact

native_fp8_execution.distinction: native FP8 execution is not implied by FP8 storage; it requires actual float8 kernels and quantized activations on the target device
required_kernels: optimizer support for the declared parameter groups
native_fp8_execution.device_evidence: none; no MPS or MLX FP8 kernel result is established
native_fp8_execution.qualification_reason: no kernel trace, gradient receipt or update receipt exists

small_reload_probe.purpose: artifact identity and reload consistency only
prohibited_inferences: reload success proves optimizer support or training qualification

estimates_expected.extension_training_dequantized_derivativ: same numerical floor as BF16 resident, distinct identity
estimates_expected.extension_training_official_fp8_resident: unquantified because activation/optimizer semantics are undefined without kernels
estimates_expected.full_base_tuning_bf16_resident: defined as an analytical upper bound only

resource_model.interpretation: Analytical estimates can block a plan; they can never qualify training. No value here is a measured memory result.

forbidden_statements: small reload success implies training qualification
dequantized derivative output is official FP8 output
official FP8 storage means native FP8 training
BF16 storage means BF16 training qualification
a successful small reload or smoke generation qualifies training
a dequantized derivative is equivalent to the official FP8 release
a dequantized derivative is equivalent to the official BF16 release
config or safetensors-header parsing proves forward parity
MiniCPM5 baseline behavior changed because a Spark path was prepared

training_qualification_gates.must_evidence: separate reviewed authorization receipt naming this exact preparation sha256
hash-verified local load receipt for the exact source identity
paired prompt tokens/logits with pre-pinned tolerances
projector input-gradient receipt with finite nonzero new gradients and unchanged base stamp
one NativeFusedAdamW step receipt with named delta and unchanged base digest
fresh-process export/reload receipt with unchanged format identity
profile samples under the 50 GiB driver, 512 MiB swap growth and 15 percent free-space guards
actual float8 kernel trace, not storage dtype inspection; required only for native FP8 claims

later_ablation.name: filtered_pre_finetuning_self_replay_text_retention_ablation
later_ablation.trigger: only after a separately authorized and evidenced Spark training qualification, and never as part of this preparation
later_ablation.purpose: Test whether filtered self-replay text during pre-finetuning preserves text retention without contaminating visual supervision.
later_ablation.replay_source: text-only self-generated continuations from the qualified model; no image-conditioned answers are replayed
filters: keep text-only rows; drop any row whose observation or target references an image, scene, caption task or visual token
drop rows that fail the existing response-contract checks
drop rows that duplicate training text or eval prompts
drop rows containing unqualified factual or numeric claims
cap replay at a declared fraction of the text batch and pin the exact replay file hash
keep replay rows in a separate split with explicit provenance

allowed_reference_labels: frozen baseline text for retention measurement only

later_ablation.measurement: held-out text continuation loss and accuracy against the frozen MiniCPM5 baseline; visual claims are out of scope
